verdict.rationale: Apple documents official SDKs (Metal 4 Tensor APIs/Neural Accelerators, Core ML, Metal Performance Shaders, Foundation Models framework, PyTorch-Metal backend) that AI-native developers can build against on M5 hardware, giving clear first-party API surfaces. However a community comment flags that Apple's ML libraries are 'insular and disconnected from the rest of the industry,' a real caveat on ecosystem openness rather than a functional failure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports building real AI apps with these SDKs, and clearer documentation/tutorials beyond marketing pages.
